purpose: Preserve strong mature battle concepts removed from Verdant's pre-Stone-Badge sequence so they can be reassigned after their species and strategies fit campaign progression.

policy.do_not_restore_verbatim_before: The selected species are naturally stage-appropriate and the player has access to the same battle gimmick, if any.
policy.selection_rule: A later encounter must fit the trainer, location, cap, surrounding battle variety, and current species-use ledger. This file is a donor library, not an allocator.

concepts.name: Mature Bug Web offense
concepts.table_reason: Three of four members are evolved forms that do not fit a cap-14 youngster route.
concepts.later_fit: A midgame Bug specialist or forest rematch once evolved insects are visually and mechanically natural.

concepts.name: Mature snow sprint
concepts.table_reason: Ninetales, Froslass, and especially Mamoswine make the first-route roster look postgame despite the strong weather design.
concepts.later_fit: Route 133 trainer Linda at cap 70. She already carries a partial Ninetales-Alola and Arctozolt shell, so the complete mature snow quartet improves an existing theme instead of displacing an unrelated trainer.

concepts.name: Mature haunted shoreline singles
concepts.table_reason: The composition is thematically excellent but reads as a fully developed coastal veteran rather than the game's first beach trainer.
concepts.later_fit: A later ocean route, abandoned ship, deep-sea area, or Billy rematch.

concepts.name: Marco Silva 2020 OCIC quartet
concepts.table_reason: The battle is excellent but visibly mature; it should not define the cap-14 youngster phase.
concepts.later_fit: A late Ace Trainer, Victory Road opponent, high-level Fisherman rematch, or tournament-style optional challenge.
